hero.title: Saituna
hero.subtitle: Bayyanar, sanarwa, ƙasa da harshe, da hanyoyin iyali.

familySection.guest: Shiga don saita bayanin iyalinka, yara, da haɗin ma'aurata.
familySection.hint: Ƙara yara kuma haɗa ma'auratanka. Kowane iyaye yana kiyaye bayanan CareMate nasa.

notifications.title: Sanarwa
notifications.permissionDeniedMessage: CareMate cannot send push alerts until you allow notifications in system settings.

location.title: Wuri
location.guestHint: Shiga don saita ƙasarka da harshenka. Baƙi suna amfani da zaɓin fara.
location.hint: Ana amfani da shi don abubuwan lafiya na yanki da zaɓin harshe.
location.searchEmpty: Babu ƙasa da ta dace da wannan bincike.

legal.title: Dokoki
legal.openFailed: An kasa buɗe hanyar haɗi. Duba haɗin kai.

account.title: Asusu
account.deleteHint: Zai share asusun CareMate da bayanan da aka haɗa har abada. Ba za a iya mayar da shi ba.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: Bayanan martaba, katin gaggawa, hanyoyin iyali, da kayan aikin lafiya da aka haɗa za a share su har abada. Biyan kuɗi masu aiki za a soke su idan ya yiwu.
account.deleteSuccessMessage: An share asusun CareMate ɗinka. Za ka iya ƙirƙira sabo kowane lokaci.
